purpose: Check whether source-conditional t20 assurance-locus genome transplant contrast from #452 persists under NEW stochastic future visitor innovations and multiple independent donor genotype samples.

prior_exposure.donor_eligibility_condition: BOTH original prehistory selected- and neutral-transmission source populations occupied at t20; original 50/64 eligibility must be recomputed exactly. No imputation of missing donor genotypes.

new_future.seed_map: original source visitor seed 61024001+i maps to new visitor transition seed 61026001+i; full 64 visitor innovations generated, only prehistory both-survivor histories used
new_future.future_visitors: canonical Model3 make_history with inherited original t20 visitor functional types and truly NEW visitor arrival/loss innovations during t20..t79; no new plant immigration
new_future.future_demographic_rng_source: reuse source run_future with future visitor seed, matching across all donor draws/modules/K for a given history, not the previously observed demographic RNG
new_future.ecological_independence_caveat: Only new post-t20 visitor innovations are independently generated. The donor genotypes and starting t20 visitor states derive from the old, already outcome-exposed 64 histories.

experiment.genome_draw: whole diploid individuals, allele_origin, mutation_flags preserved; one selected source draw and one neutral source draw per source history x resample, then reuse EXACT recipient genomes across K and mosaic cells

primary.contrast: At target K8, selected_assurance_only minus neutral_all survival from t20 to t80, averaged equally over three whole-genotype draws PER eligible source history.
primary.inference_unit: 50 previously outcome-exposed donor-history clusters; three genotype-draws nested, one fresh matched future visitor innovation per cluster
primary.summary: difference of unconditional post-transplant survival averages conditional on t20 donor-eligibility, NOT unconditional survival from t0
primary.uncertainty: 1999 paired cluster bootstrap replicates over 50 donor original history IDs, averaging three nested whole-genome resamples within each history; in addition Hoeffding 95% distribution-free bound for bounded per-cluster differences [-1,1]
primary.decision: resolved positive only if BOTH clustered percentile bootstrap and distribution-free Hoeffding lower bounds exceed +0.05; resolved negative only if BOTH upper bounds below -0.05; practical equivalence only if BOTH intervals entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05]; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Bootstrap alone cannot certify equivalence in all-equal outcomes.

secondary: repeat same assurance-only contrast at K48, descriptive
match/ investment-only source contrast and assurance selected-other counterpart at both K, descriptive
paired selection-insensitive sham genomic module parity
factorial two-order assurance/other-loci descriptive allocation, no unique causal mediation
difference between single-draw and pooled multi-draw dispersion
strict_replay_gates: Full previously archived source counts selected=58 neutral=52 both=50 exactly replayed; retain 14 excluded histories in receipt
Run all 1200 post20 futures, no elimination by observed survival or genotype support

No original 61024001..64 visitor innovations used for future updates t20..79; new future visitor IDs 61026001..64 are generated from canonical independent RNG histories conditional on each original year20 visitor state
All four genomic compositions preserve source entire homolog pairs and origin/flags; selected-all and neutral-all remain donor whole-genome controls
At any fixed source index and draw, same exact 8 transplanted genomes used for both K; future ecological state and demographic RNG stream aligned across all mosaic cells
No new mutation, plant immigration, K-driven change to original initial census N0=8, no modifications of production Model3 biology
False claims of 150 independent visitors or prospectively independently sampled 50 donor histories forbidden
Floors, ceilings, and all null contrasts reported, no after-outcome seed/budget/ROPE revisions promoted
scope: Model-internal conditional future-environment transfer only, planned after earlier positive source-mosaic exploratory effect. Not external field validation, not proof of evolutionary suicide/rescue or locus-specific historical genetic mediation.
